gate_r1_plant.claim: under the ramp from h to 1.5h the quarter-cell wall plant still fails the wall's shift against the planar calibration at every drawn sub-cell offset, and the clean wall passes it
gate_r1_plant.case: tests/flow/test_fvm_ramp.py::test_r1_the_walls_shift_holds_the_planar_calibration_at_a_drawn_offset, the straight tube at D/h 16, steady

prediction.unit: cells, |shift - planar| on the clean wall
prediction.why: S1: the smooth band's shift +0.01 cells over sub-cell positions; the first step: the new ramp moves the shift at most 4.6e-4 cells

gate_r1_plant.metric: the flux-effective radius's shift against the plane channel's under the same band and ramp

control.plant: the solver's radius a quarter cell outward
control.resolution: the quarter cell against the 0.15-cell line; the range measured by discriminating_range on the tube

gate_r1_plant.if_wrong: a miss means the reshaped ramp makes the shift depend on the sub-cell position: the h-to-3h ramp stays and R1 is named
gate_r1_plant.cannot_discriminate_if: the planar calibration moved with the plant (it does not: it is a separate plane channel)

gate_r2_stenosis_occlusion.claim: through a 75 % stenosis the new ramp's bypass is no larger than the old's and the flux moves under 3e-3; through a full occlusion its leak is no larger; at 0.1h and 0.01h
gate_r2_stenosis_occlusion.case: tests/flow/test_fvm_ramp.py::test_r2_*, tube trees at D/h 16, float64

prediction.unit: new/old bypass and leak ratios; the stenosis's flux moved within +-1e-3
prediction.why: the stiff interior starts at the band's edge either way and reaches full stiffness at 1.5h instead of 3h, so the solid between 1.5h and 3h conducts (delta_in/delta)^2 of the band's instead of up to the band's; the lumen sees the wall's shift move by under 5e-4 cells

gate_r2_stenosis_occlusion.metric: bypass_ratio, and the box's whole flux

control.expected_rate: every draw on the stenosis's bypass
control.resolution: a ramp ending past the old one leaks more

gate_r2_stenosis_occlusion.if_wrong: the h-to-3h ramp stays and R2 is named
gate_r2_stenosis_occlusion.cannot_discriminate_if: the bypass is zero in both arms (it is not: a periodic box's solid conducts)

gate_r3_float32.claim: float32 at its default stop raises no solve flag on the tube and the stenosis under the new ramp, its flux within 1e-4 of float64's

prediction.why: #224's residual tests: float32 within 1.5e-6 to 5e-6 of float64 at its floor stop on the stenosis; the ramp does not change the stop

gate_r3_float32.metric: the box's flux; the report's at_cap, stagnated, not_finite

control.plant: float32 held to a tolerance of 1e-9, under its rounding floor
control.resolution: a stop held below the floor cannot converge

gate_r3_float32.if_wrong: a flag on a correct float32 run under the new ramp: the h-to-3h ramp stays and R3 is named
gate_r3_float32.cannot_discriminate_if: float64 and float32 both run at a tolerance looser than the line

gate_r4_iterations.claim: through the stenosis at the 0.01h interior the new ramp takes at most 1.2 times the old ramp's CG iterations, steady and IMEX Euler

prediction.why: a steeper ramp raises the penalty's gradient in the solid, but Jacobi scales each face by its own diagonal; the first step saw no change on the open tube

control.plant: the new arm's interior ten times stiffer (0.001h)
control.resolution: the 0.01h interior took about ten times 0.1h's iterations (B3), so a tenfold stiffer one crosses 1.2

gate_r4_iterations.if_wrong: the h-to-3h ramp stays and R4 is named

gate_contract.claim: the node's wall is the union's exact distance on the faces it holds, and every face it does not hold lies where the fields are flat; its counts are zero at the values built

prediction.why: the node evaluates the same union on the same points; its plan holds every failing face

gate_contract.metric: max |phi_node - phi_union| over the held faces

control.resolution: the minimum is 0.8 to 1 cell off at a junction at D/h 8 (2a's gate 1)

gate_contract.if_wrong: the node reads another distance than the union's
gate_contract.cannot_discriminate_if: no face fails the union's check (a draw with no junction in the box: never, the loop has two)

gate_fa2_curved.claim: on a helical tube (kappa a 0.15) the band does not displace the lumen: Dean's first-order profile fitted with a free centre puts it within 0.05 cells of the centreline along the principal normal, its free radius's shift within 0.15 of the planar calibration

prediction.why: F1a's spike: the mean shift moves at most 0.004 cells with kappa a 0.3; the band reads an exact distance, so the inner and outer walls shift alike to O(kappa h); Dean's O(kappa^2) terms are even about the binormal, torsion enters at O(kappa tau), about 0.02 of the first-order term

gate_fa2_curved.metric: the fitted centre's offset along the principal normal

control.resolution: the fit reads the plant's 0.1 to within the displacement's own error

gate_fa2_curved.if_wrong: a displacement over the line: the band's shift depends on the side of the bend, a curvature indicator is needed (B3's first route); FA2 is named and the curved wall's validity says so
gate_fa2_curved.cannot_discriminate_if: the fit without Dean's term were used (it puts the centre about 0.7 cells inward by the physics alone)

gate_fa3_taper.claim: along a biconical taper (radius 0.5 to 0.3 over 3 D) the wall's shift inferred against lubrication's flux is within 0.15 cells of the planar calibration

prediction.why: lubrication's error is O(slope^2) = 4e-3 relative, about 0.006 cells through the sensitivity (0.66 a cell); the band's jitter 0.03

gate_fa3_taper.metric: ln(Q / Q_lub) / (h d ln Q / d delta)

control.plant: every radius a quarter cell out
control.resolution: the quarter cell against the 0.15 line

gate_fa3_taper.if_wrong: the shift depends on the slope: the taper's slope gets a validity line
gate_fa3_taper.cannot_discriminate_if: the sensitivity were zero (it is 0.66 a cell)

gate_fa4_ellipse.claim: on an elliptic section (semi-axes 0.5 and 0.3 D) each semi-axis shifts within 0.1 cells of a round tube's shift by the same estimator

prediction.why: the band reads the exact distance; the section's curvature (radius 0.18 to 0.83 D) enters as kappa h, at most 0.35 at the major vertex at D/h 16, which F1a's spike bounds at 0.004 cells for kappa a 0.3 along a tube; the ellipse's is across it, untested

gate_fa4_ellipse.metric: the interior quadratic's zero level's semi-axes

control.plant: the solver's major semi-axis a quarter cell longer
control.resolution: the quarter cell against the 0.1 line

gate_fa4_ellipse.if_wrong: the shift depends on the wall's curvature across the section: a validity line on the section's least radius of curvature in cells
gate_fa4_ellipse.cannot_discriminate_if: the round tube's estimator drifted the same way (it is the same estimator; the plant is on one axis)

gate_fa5_stenosis.claim: through a 75 % stenosis (throat 8 cells across at D/h 16) the wall's shift inferred against the Richardson reference's flux is within 0.15 cells of the planar calibration
gate_fa5_stenosis.case: tests/flow/test_fvm_general_wall.py::test_fa5_the_stenosis_holds_the_planar_calibration_against_its_reference; the reference by tests/flow/generate_wall_references.py at D/h 32 and 64 on Actions

prediction.why: B3: the shift is constant in cells on straight tubes down to 8 cells across with the error growing (+2.1 % of flux at 16, +10.8 % at 8); the throat is 8 cells across at D/h 16

gate_fa5_stenosis.metric: ln(Q16 / Q_ref) / (h d ln Q / d delta), the sensitivity lubrication's

control.plant: every radius a quarter cell out
control.resolution: the quarter cell against the 0.15 line

gate_fa5_stenosis.if_wrong: the shift at a throat departs from the calibration: a throat line in cells (round 1, item 2's criterion)
gate_fa5_stenosis.cannot_discriminate_if: the reference were taken from the same resolution

gate_fa6_bifurcation.claim: the split-and-merge loop's split at 30 degrees (daughters 0.4 and 0.3 D, filleted) at D/h 16 lies within 0.01 of its Richardson reference, the vessel turned off the grid's planes

prediction.why: the first step: the split converges at first order, 0.7416 / 0.7444 / 0.7458 at 16 / 32 / 64

gate_fa6_bifurcation.metric: the first daughter's share of the two daughters' axial flux at the loop's middle

control.plant: the first daughter a quarter cell out
control.resolution: the plant moves the split about 0.03 at D/h 16 (R^4)

gate_fa6_bifurcation.if_wrong: the carina's discretisation error exceeds a straight tube's: the split's line at D/h 16 is the record's, refinement the route

reference_values.claim: the references the gates read: the loop's split at fillet 0.1 extrapolated from D/h 32 and 64 (mean over four draws), and the stenosis's flux likewise

prediction.why: the first step's fillet-0.03 arm extrapolated: 2 x 0.74566 - 0.74422 = 0.7471

reference_values.stenosis: the stenosis's flux within 3 % of lubrication's (the cones' slope 0.25: lubrication's error a few per cent)

gate_fa7_symmetric.claim: the symmetric loop's split is a half within 0.005 at random turns about z and sub-cell offsets, never on a grid plane

prediction.why: the first step: 0.4995 to 0.5010 over ten draws at D/h 16

control.plant: the first daughter a quarter cell out

gate_fa7_symmetric.if_wrong: the junction's jitter exceeds the line: its line is set from the measured spread
gate_fa7_symmetric.cannot_discriminate_if: the draw sat on a symmetry plane (draws are 1 to 89 degrees off)

gate_fa8_derivative.claim: the first daughter's flux's derivative in its radius, reverse mode through the steady step (the band, the union's implicit derivatives, the solve), equals the central difference within one discretisation to 1e-4

prediction.why: the central difference at 5e-5 of the radius stays inside the held faces and the plan; its truncation ~1e-7 against the ripple's curvature, its rounding ~1e-7 at the solve's 1e-12

control.plant: the radii held out of the derivative (stop_gradient)

gate_fa8_derivative.if_wrong: the derivative through the union's implicit step or the held faces is wrong: FA8 is named and the tree's geometry derivative stays unverified
gate_fa8_derivative.cannot_discriminate_if: the step moved a face out of the held set (the counts are asserted zero)

corrections_2026_11_11.written: 2026-11-11, after the first gates' run (probe run 42912350837 on 91d22db) and before the second: what the first run changed, and the predictions it adds; the predictions above are unchanged
corrections_2026_11_11.ramp: R2 failed on the stenosis at the 0.1h interior (bypass 9.65e-4 against 9.43e-4, the flux -0.44 % past its 3e-3 line), so by row #315 the h-to-3h ramp stays (78a1118) and the ramp's gates leave the PR; FA2 to FA8 are judged under the h-to-3h ramp from here
corrections_2026_11_11.fa8_defect: FA8 failed (reverse 0.0836 against the central difference 0.0875): forward mode agreed with the central difference and reverse mode did not, on a batch of the node's held faces only (one face set alone agreed). Cause: jnp.min and jnp.minimum find the least's derivative by comparing it again with their operands, which XLA computed twice in fusions rounding them differently. Fixed by selecting the least by one comparison (3bc006f); after it, reverse 0.08699297129385 against forward 0.08699297129385 and central differences 0.0870068 / 0.0869926 / 0.0869930 / 0.0869930 at steps 2e-3 / 2e-4 / 2e-5 / 2e-6
